summary: Backend + frontend payment regression test executed. Core payment reset fix for existing orders #1/#2 verified on edit form, but editing TEMP fixtures exposed another blocking UI regression in related selects during update flow.

ui_bugs.issue: On TEMP payment fixtures, update flow (change only amount/note, untouched payment) does not return to list; form stays open. Captured state shows payment selected but color select rendered as placeholder, indicating unrelated select value loss in edit mode and blocking submit validation.

integration_issues.flow: Edit existing TEMP order -> change only amount/note -> save
integration_issues.issue: Expected PUT+table refresh did not complete in UI runs because edit form remained open; this blocks full persistence verification from UI side even though API-level persistence tests pass.

action_items: Investigate edit-mode select state for non-payment fields (especially color/base related Radix Selects) to prevent unintended empty/placeholder state before submit.
After fix, rerun full UI persistence matrix: 4 payment types, unrelated update save/reopen, intentional payment change, cancel unsaved change, cross-order stale-state, mobile payment section check.
Keep scope limited to OrderForm/select handling; do not change unrelated modules.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment-only hardening exists, but other Select fields still appear vulnerable to empty initialization/state drift in edit mode.
Edit submit validation depends on color for LED; if color silently drops to placeholder, save path is blocked and appears as payment-persistence failure.
seed_data_creation: Created TEMP_Payment_* fixtures via real API during tests; cleaned up created fixture IDs. Also removed stray TEMP_Payment_Repro fixture (order_no=18).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed from real UI: order #1 shows Web and #2 shows Havale in edit form and remained stable after async district wait. Payment dropdown options are 4 and non-empty. New order keeps payment placeholder by default; submit without payment blocked; submit with payment works. Blocker starts in edit TEMP fixtures save flow where unrelated select state appears to drop (notably color), causing save flow not to complete.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: create LED order with color=Mavi + payment set -> open edit -> do not touch payment, change amount/note, save. Observed form remains open instead of returning to list; captured screen shows select-color placeholder while payment remains selected. Likely same hidden native/Radix empty-event pattern affects other selects through generic handleSelectChange path, not only payment_type. Mitigation: guard against empty native-init updates for vulnerable required selects in edit mode and use functional state updates consistently.
